selectionEntries.name: King Ezekiel, Leader of the Kingdom

profiles.name: King Ezekiel, Leader of the Kingdom

rules.name: Hail to the King
rules.description: When Ezekiel uses his Encourage ability, all Friendly Kingdom models in his Kill Zone receive a +1 Action counter, rather than a single target model, at no extra SP cost.

rules.name: For the Kingdom! (Special Order)
rules.description: Once per game, when Ezekiel declares a Follow Me! special order, he may use this rule instead. Perform the order exactly like the Follow Me! rule. However, Ezekiel and any friendly Kingdom model moved by this order that ends the move engaged with an enemy adds 1White to its melee attack rolls this round.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: If the attack scores any !, add 1Red to the roll. Against Walkers, add 1White instead.

rules.name: Formation Charge
rules.description: Models from the Kingdom Faction may reroll blanks when taking Melee attack rolls while there is at least one other friendly Kingdom model in their Kill Zone.

rules.name: Knights of the Realm
rules.description: Any Kingdom model mounted on a Horse adds 1Red to its Melee attack rolls. Furthermore, each time a Kingdom model on a Horse scores three or more ! as part of a Melee attack roll, add 1SP to the Strategy Pool for the round.

rules.name: Ferocious Loyalty
rules.description: Shiva may only be included in a group that also includes King Ezekiel. While Shive is in King Ezekiel's Kill Zone Add1Red to his Defense. And Shiva's Multiple Attacks Keyword is increased to (3).

rules.name: Feeding Time
rules.description: If Shiva wishes to perform an Action while in contact with a Prone enemy, she must first roll 1Black. On a Shield, she may perform the Action as normal. On a Blank, she loses the Action, but automatically removes one Prone enemy in contact.

rules.name: Probation
rules.description: If Benjamin begins his activation more than 8" from the group's Leader, roll 1Black. On a blank, he loses 1 Action, but adds 1SP to the Strategy Pool for the round. On a Shield, he adds 1White to his Defense until the start of his next activation.

rules.name: Close Protection
rules.description: If Richard is unengaged and a friendly King Ezekiel model in his Kill Zone is attacked in melee, you may spend 1 SP to place Richard in base contact with the attacking enemy. Richard immediately becomes the target of the melee attack. You may use this ability even if Richard has an Activated token.

rules.name: Close Protection
rules.description: As an Action, spend 1SP to have Richard or a single unengaged friendly model within 6" create NOISE. Alternatively, spend 2SP to create MAYHEM instead. If the selected model is unengaged after the NOISE/MAYHEM is resolved, they may immediately perform a free, out-of-sequence Move Action (even if they've already activated this round, and even if they've already Moved).

rules.name: Chivalric Code
rules.description: If Taylor wounds an enemy model in melee while Outnumbered, immediately gain 1SP. However, if Taylor is on the Outnumbering side when targeting an enemy Survivor in melee, he must reroll all scores of ! for that melee attack.

rules.name: Trustworthy
rules.description: Once per round, spend 1SP to choose one friendly model in Gus' Kill Zone yet to activate. That model receives an Activated token, but adds 1Red to its Defense for th remainder of the round. When Gus completes this activation, he does not receive an Activated token - he may activate again this round (but cannot use this ability when he does).
